items.statement: The investigation maps deposited CCDC 2453269 to system 1/complex 1 (Br) and CCDC 2453268 to system 2/complex 2 (Cl), then tracks the parity-compatible neutral doublet and one-electron-reduced singlet Cu states.
items.expected: Both supplied records are matched by archive ID, formula and cell to the documented chemical system order (1=Br=2453269; 2=Cl=2453268); formal charges 0/-1, executable multiplicities 2/1 and Cu identity are traceably documented. The report distinguishes this parity repair from the source-reported 3/2 states.

items.statement: The comparison is based on validated, converged charge differences using a consistent atomic-charge definition.
items.expected: Convergence and charge-partitioning evidence is supplied, with bounded failure honestly reported if needed.

items.statement: The source reference Cu f_k+ values are 0.0182 for complex 1 (Br; CCDC 2453269) and 0.0299 for complex 2 (Cl; CCDC 2453268).
items.expected: Reported values reproduce the source values approximately, preserve their ordering and match results by complex identity rather than ascending CCDC number.

items.statement: The computed Cu f_k+ comparison supports a more electrophilic Cu site in complex 2 and is consistent with its stronger reported catecholase activity, subject to model limitations.
items.expected: The final interpretation independently connects the larger 2 value to activity while distinguishing support from proof.
